priority.name: ocApplySequenceCuts
priority.replacement_plan: Landed 2026-08-20 (F349): applyCuts builds a TrackItemSelection and runs createRemoveItemsAction inside Project.executeTransaction, verified by the existing host-write read-back contract. It stays partial because the action removes whole track items and the typed API exposes no razor, so a cut whose range crosses a track-item boundary — silence inside one clip, the common case — still falls back to sequence.rippleDelete() and records why. Emulating a razor with clone plus set-start/set-end actions, and confirming the ripple accounting, needs F252's live-host lane before the CEP fallback can be dropped.
priority.role: Remove or trim timeline ranges and ripple-delete where requested.

priority.name: ocAddNativeCaptionTrack
priority.replacement_plan: Keep CEP fallback while available; prioritize F253 Hybrid Plugin caption-track creation or adopt an Adobe UXP API if it ships. Until then the supported UXP-era path is exporting the SRT sidecar for manual import.
priority.role: Create a native Premiere caption track from SRT-style segments.

priority.name: ocQeReflect
priority.replacement_plan: Retire QE reflection after CEP EOL rather than seeking a successor; replace any real workflow that depends on it one by one with documented UXP APIs and F267 UDT evidence.
priority.role: Reflect undocumented QE DOM methods for diagnostics.

exclusions./jobs: CEP job-status polling transport; UXP uses JobPoller internally.

pending_reasons.automation: Workflow, template, preset, and batch surfaces. These compose other routes, so they port after the routes they call.
pending_reasons.delivery: Social platform metadata, export presets, and thumbnails. Blocked with the rest of the export surface on UXP encoder work.
pending_reasons.plumbing: Settings, diagnostics, job history, and process control. Mostly served in UXP by panel-local state or the typed host APIs rather than by porting the CEP endpoint one for one; each still needs a decision, so they are tracked rather than excluded.
pending_reasons.timeline: Timeline organisation helpers (renaming, smart bins, beat cuts). Depend on host write paths still being validated on 26.3.
pending_reasons.transcript: Caption styling, burn-in segments, and alternate ASR backends. The core transcribe path is already covered; these are the extras.
pending_reasons.video-effects: Compositing, colour, titles, transitions, and speed. The largest single block and the least started on the UXP side.
pending_reasons.video-restore: Face, upscale, watermark, and interpolation models. Long-running model jobs that need the UXP durable-job surface first.

rows.name: ocPing
rows.replacement_plan: Inline in the UXP panel bridge; no CEP fallback required.
rows.role: Synchronous health probe for the CEP host bridge.
rows.uxp_path: Return a direct health response from the UXP host module.

rows.name: ocGetSequenceInfo
rows.replacement_plan: Keep the UXP bridge implementation as the canonical path.
rows.role: Read the active sequence identity, dimensions, frame rate, and duration.
rows.uxp_path: PProBridge.getSequenceInfo() via Sequence settings and active project state.

rows.name: ocAddSequenceMarkers
rows.replacement_plan: Port callers to the UXP bridge and retain CEP only for legacy hosts.
rows.role: Create timeline markers from backend-generated marker payloads.

rows.name: ocGetSequenceMarkers
rows.replacement_plan: Use the same shape as CEP so backend marker contracts stay stable.
rows.role: Read active-sequence markers for round-trip metadata workflows.

rows.name: ocApplySequenceCuts
rows.replacement_plan: Landed 2026-08-20 (F349): applyCuts builds a TrackItemSelection and runs createRemoveItemsAction inside Project.executeTransaction, verified by the existing host-write read-back contract. It stays partial because the action removes whole track items and the typed API exposes no razor, so a cut whose range crosses a track-item boundary — silence inside one clip, the common case — still falls back to sequence.rippleDelete() and records why. Emulating a razor with clone plus set-start/set-end actions, and confirming the ripple accounting, needs F252's live-host lane before the CEP fallback can be dropped.
rows.role: Remove or trim timeline ranges and ripple-delete where requested.
rows.uxp_path: SequenceEditor.getEditor(sequence).createRemoveItemsAction(trackItemSelection, ripple, mediaType, shiftOverLapping?) -> Action (confirmed 2026-08-20 in @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings, src/premierepro.d.ts:3203-3232). Run through Project.executeTransaction so the edit is undoable and its effect is observable — preferred over sequence.rippleDelete(), which premiere-pro-mcp #21 measured returning success while changing nothing on 26.3.

rows.name: ocApplyClipKeyframes
rows.replacement_plan: Port as a UXP bridge operation once feature-level UDT covers keyframes.
rows.role: Apply opacity, scale, position, or other keyframe payloads to clips.
rows.uxp_path: Component and property keyframe APIs on UXP clip items.

rows.name: ocBatchRenameProjectItems
rows.replacement_plan: Treat as low-priority convenience wiring in the UXP bridge.
rows.role: Rename selected project items in bulk.

rows.name: ocCreateSmartBins
rows.replacement_plan: Move bin creation behind the UXP project bridge.
rows.role: Create bins for organized project-item workflows.
rows.uxp_path: Project root item and bin creation APIs.

rows.name: ocAddNativeCaptionTrack
rows.replacement_plan: Keep CEP fallback while available; prioritize F253 Hybrid Plugin caption-track creation or adopt an Adobe UXP API if it ships. Until then the supported UXP-era path is exporting the SRT sidecar for manual import.
rows.role: Create a native Premiere caption track from SRT-style segments.
rows.uxp_path: No UXP caption-track write API as of 26.3 (audited 2026-08-20 against @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings). CaptionTrack exposes only getCaptionTrackCount, getCaptionTrack(index), createSetNameAction, and setMute — read, rename, and mute. Transcript.createImportTextSegmentsAction targets a ClipProjectItem transcript, which is a different object from a sequence caption track and is not a substitute.

rows.name: ocGetProjectBins
rows.replacement_plan: Use UXP project-tree traversal and keep response shape stable.
rows.role: List project bins for import and organization workflows.

rows.name: ocExportSequenceRange
rows.replacement_plan: Route to UXP export APIs as part of F255 encoder integration.

rows.name: ocRemoveSequenceMarkers
rows.replacement_plan: Use UXP marker deletion for parity with marker import/export routes.

rows.name: ocUnrenameItems
rows.replacement_plan: Share the batch-rename UXP bridge path.

rows.name: ocRemoveImportedSequence
rows.replacement_plan: Use UXP project-item deletion with explicit result reporting.
rows.role: Remove a sequence imported for preview or interchange workflows.

rows.name: ocSetSequencePlayhead
rows.replacement_plan: Expose as a UXP bridge utility for review and marker navigation.
rows.role: Move the active sequence playhead to a target time.

rows.name: ocRemoveImportedItem
rows.role: Remove an imported project item by identity.

rows.name: ocQeReflect
rows.replacement_plan: Retire QE reflection after CEP EOL rather than seeking a successor; replace any real workflow that depends on it one by one with documented UXP APIs and F267 UDT evidence.
rows.role: Reflect undocumented QE DOM methods for diagnostics.
rows.uxp_path: No supported UXP QE DOM equivalent (audited 2026-08-20 against @adobe/premierepro 26.3.0 typings: no qe, reflect, executeScript, or evalScript surface exists). QE reflection is a CEP/ExtendScript debug facility, not a user feature, so it retires rather than ports.

rows.name: ocEmitPingEvent
rows.replacement_plan: Replace the event transport while keeping the acknowledgement semantics.
rows.role: Emit a panel acknowledgement event for host/panel round trips.
rows.uxp_path: UXP addon events or direct backend callback instead of CSXSEvent.

rows.name: ocReadPanelBootstrapToken
rows.replacement_plan: Keep the secret contract identical and swap only the file-read transport when CEP retires.
rows.role: Read the local CSRF bootstrap secret so a file:// panel can prove it is host-embedded and not a web page.
rows.uxp_path: UXP reads the same secret through its own localFileSystem permission; no ExtendScript bridge is involved.
